label: Text 1
transcript: Naima is interviewing the school caretaker, Mrs. Brock, who has worked at the school for 21 years and claims to remember every student's name. She is almost certainly exaggerating. Naima has prepared eight open questions and one fall-back question, tell me about a student you remember, in case the interview stalls.
